136 -\. A G. KRISHNAREDDY v. SAJJAPPA (D) BY LRS. AND ANR. (Civil Appeal No. 4255 of 2002) JULY 18, 2011 r B [DR. MUKUNDAKAM SHARMA AND ANIL R. DAVE, JJ.) Karnataka Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes c (Prohibition of Transfer of Certain Lands) Act, 1978: ss. 4 and 5 - Land granted for 15 - Plea of adverse possession > D raised by purchaser- HELD: High Court has rightly held that the plea of adverse possession was not available to the purchaser.
